mapper.select: SELECT homepage_id, locker_number, locker_type FROM UNTACT_BOOK_LOCKER_SETTING WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id} ORDER BY locker_number

SELECT a.locker_number, a.locker_type, b.reservation_step FROM UNTACT_BOOK_LOCKER_SETTING A LEFT JOIN UNTACT_BOOK_RESERVATION B ON a.homepage_id = b.homepage_id AND a.locker_number = b.locker_number AND b.cancel_yn = 'N' AND b.round_idx = (SELECT round_idx FROM UNTACT_BOOK_ROUND WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND round_end_date = (SELECT round_start_date FROM UNTACT_BOOK_ROUND WHERE 1=1 AND homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND round_idx = #{round_idx} ) ) WHERE a.homepage_id = #{homepage_id}
SELECT locker_number, locker_type FROM UNTACT_BOOK_LOCKER_SETTING WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id}
SELECT NVL(MAX(locker_number), 0) FROM UNTACT_BOOK_LOCKER_SETTING WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM UNTACT_BOOK_LOCKER_SETTING WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND locker_type = '도서대출'

SELECT homepage_id, locker_use_yn, locker_type, row_count, total_count, reservation_repeated_day, SUBSTR(reservation_time,0,2) AS reserve_start_hour, SUBSTR(reservation_time,4,2) AS reserve_start_minute, SUBSTR(reservation_time,7,2) AS reserve_end_hour, SUBSTR(reservation_time,10,2) AS reserve_end_minute, SUBSTR(loan_time,0,2) AS loan_end_hour, SUBSTR(loan_time,4,2) AS loan_end_minute, SUBSTR(reservation_repeated_time,0,2) AS repeated_start_hour, SUBSTR(reservation_repeated_time,4,2) AS repeated_start_minute, locker_use_type, locker_type, terms, night_loan_yn FROM UNTACT_BOOK_SETTING WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id}
mapper.update: MERGE INTO UNTACT_BOOK_SETTING a USING dual ON (a.homepage_id = #{homepage_id}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET a.locker_use_yn = #{locker_use_yn}, a.locker_type = #{locker_type}, a.row_count = #{row_count}, a.total_count = #{total_count}, a.reservation_repeated_day = #{reservation_repeated_day}, a.reservation_time = #{reserve_start_hour}||':'||#{reserve_start_minute}||'~'||#{reserve_end_hour}||':'||#{reserve_end_minute}, a.loan_time = #{loan_end_hour}||':'||#{loan_end_minute}, a.reservation_repeated_time = #{repeated_start_hour}||':'||#{repeated_start_minute}, a.locker_use_type = #{locker_use_type}, a.terms = #{terms}, a.night_loan_yn = #{night_loan_yn} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( homepage_id, locker_use_yn, row_count, total_count, locker_type, reservation_repeated_day, reservation_time, loan_time, locker_use_type, terms, night_loan_yn, reservation_repeated_time ) VALUES ( #{homepage_id}, #{locker_use_yn}, #{row_count}, #{total_count}, #{locker_type}, #{reservation_repeated_day}, #{reserve_start_hour}||':'||#{reserve_start_minute}||'~'||#{reserve_end_hour}||':'||#{reserve_end_minute}, #{loan_end_hour}||':'||#{loan_end_minute}, #{locker_use_type}, #{terms}, #{night_loan_yn}, #{repeated_start_hour}||':'||#{repeated_start_minute} )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM UNTACT_BOOK_SETTING WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND (TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24:MI') < TO_CHAR(SUBSTR(reservation_time,0,2)||':'||SUBSTR(reservation_time,4,2)) OR TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24:MI') > TO_CHAR(SUBSTR(reservation_time,7,2)||':'||SUBSTR(reservation_time,10,2)))
SELECT reservation_max_count FROM UNTACT_BOOK_SETTING WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id}
SELECT loan_time FROM UNTACT_BOOK_SETTING WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id}
SELECT locker_use_type FROM UNTACT_BOOK_SETTING WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id}
SELECT NVL(MAX(total_count),0) FROM UNTACT_BOOK_SETTING WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id}
SELECT locker_use_yn FROM UNTACT_BOOK_SETTING WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO UNTACT_BOOK_ROUND ( homepage_id, round_idx, round_start_date, round_end_date, round_start_time, round_end_time, add_date ) VALUES ( #{homepage_id}, #{round_idx}, #{round_start_date}, #{round_end_date}, #{round_start_time}, ( SELECT TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{round_end_time}, 'HH24:MI:SS')-1/(24*60*60), 'HH24:MI:SS') as round_end_time FROM DUAL ), SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT round_idx FROM UNTACT_BOOK_ROUND WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND SYSDATE BETWEEN TO_DATE(round_start_date||round_start_time, 'YYYY-MM-DDHH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(round_end_date||round_end_time, 'YYYY-MM-DDHH24:MI:SS')

SELECT round_idx FROM UNTACT_BOOK_ROUND WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND round_idx = ( SELECT round_idx FROM UNTACT_BOOK_ROUND WHERE 1=1 AND homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND SYSDATE BETWEEN TO_DATE(round_start_date||round_start_time, 'YYYY-MM-DDHH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(round_end_date||round_end_time, 'YYYY-MM-DDHH24:MI:SS') )

SELECT round_idx FROM UNTACT_BOOK_ROUND WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND round_idx = (SELECT MAX(round_idx) as round_idx FROM UNTACT_BOOK_ROUND WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND round_idx < ( SELECT round_idx FROM UNTACT_BOOK_ROUND WHERE 1=1 AND homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND SYSDATE BETWEEN TO_DATE(round_start_date||round_start_time, 'YYYY-MM-DDHH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(round_end_date||round_end_time, 'YYYY-MM-DDHH24:MI:SS') ) )

SELECT round_idx FROM UNTACT_BOOK_ROUND WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND ROUND_END_DATE = (SELECT ROUND_START_DATE FROM UNTACT_BOOK_ROUND WHERE 1=1 AND homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND round_idx = #{round_idx})

SELECT TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(round_start_date||round_start_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'),'YYYYMMDDHH24miss') AS round_start_date, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(round_end_date||round_end_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'),'YYYYMMDDHH24miss') AS round_end_date FROM UNTACT_BOOK_ROUND WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND round_idx = #{round_idx}

SELECT TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(a.round_start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'MM-DD')||' 18:00 ~ '||TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(a.round_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'MM-DD')||' '||b.loan_time AS round_end_date FROM UNTACT_BOOK_ROUND a, UNTACT_BOOK_SETTING b WHERE a.homepage_id = b.homepage_id AND a.homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND round_idx = (SELECT round_idx FROM UNTACT_BOOK_ROUND WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND round_start_date = (SELECT round_end_date FROM UNTACT_BOOK_ROUND WHERE 1=1 AND homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND round_idx = #{round_idx} ) )

SELECT TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(a.round_start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'MM-DD')||' 18:00 ~ '||TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(a.round_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'MM-DD')||' '||b.loan_time AS round_end_date FROM UNTACT_BOOK_ROUND a, UNTACT_BOOK_SETTING b WHERE a.homepage_id = b.homepage_id AND a.homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND a.round_idx = #{round_idx}
